title: OpenDeepThink: Parallel Reasoning via Bradley–Terry Aggregation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating pointwise LLM judgment accuracy on accepted versus wrong candidate solutions using a 500-pair diagnostic to demonstrate that pointwise judges achieve high recall on correct answers but poor recall on wrong ones (failing to reliably reject incorrect solutions).
Randomizing the presentation order of candidate solutions (Solution A and Solution B) during pairwise LLM comparison to prevent the judge model from favoring a specific position.
